Pulse 0.6.3

What's fixed:
- Longbridge quotes now carry the actual market-data package and timestamp freshness negotiated by the official SDK, so Pulse can distinguish real-time quotes from 15-minute delayed quotes.
- Delayed Longbridge quotes yield to a fresher fallback source when one is available, and symbol details show the source and delay that were actually used.
- Longbridge OAuth identity no longer changes with the Mac's region or time zone. Existing sessions remain valid, while affected users can refresh authorization from Longbridge settings.

Most users do not need to sign in again after updating. If Longbridge settings report delayed access, use Refresh Longbridge Authorization to renegotiate the quote package.

For first-time installation, download Pulse-0.6.3.dmg and drag Pulse to Applications. The zip asset is used by Sparkle automatic updates.
